document.title: After the selloff, six markets lack a common shock signal
document.canonical_content_text:
Stand aside in all six markets.

The small risk-off moves after 00:00Z (USDJPY -13 pips to 159.393, SPX -6 points to 7424.41, BTCUSD to 64647.11) coincide with the Tokyo cash open after a -2.3% US session and are read as continuation of Monday's selloff, an estimate that cannot be proven inside one M5 bar.

USDJPY and BTCUSD held the risk-off direction after 00:00Z while GOLD and EURUSD moved against a haven reading; the markets do not agree on a shock.

A large risk-off day is already in the prices: SPX about -2.3% and WTI about -3.7% against the last completed daily closes in the reference capture, with SPX near its session low and WTI and GOLD at the floors of their 20-day ranges. No geopolitical premium was added after the headline.

Base case (55%): BTCUSD is at or below 64647.11 at 2026-11-18T00:07:58Z, a weak with-trend lean. Mechanism: equity risk-off and a computed down trend; the selling began at 23:30Z, before the headline. Priced: a fall from about 73990 to 64650 in five days. Positioning: not observed. Driver: Monday's risk-off, not the Iran report. Acceptance: ACCEPTED in direction (below the nine-hour low 64726.80) but the channel to the shock is MIXED. Zone reason: price sits 1.1% above Monday's H1 low 63941.57, inside the day's range. Invalidation reason: an H1 close above 65476.48 would show the dip bought. Confirmations: an H1 close below 63941.57. Invalidation: completed H1 bar closing above 65476.48. Opposite mechanism: exhaustion bounce after a 12.6% fall.
Main alternative (45%): BTCUSD is above 64647.11 at the horizon after holding Monday's low.

A completed H1 bar closing above 65476.48 ends the short lean.

Base case (51%): EURUSD is at or below 1.10023 at 2026-11-18T00:07:58Z, effectively no lean. Mechanism: a US-soil security report has no clean sign for the pair. Priced: a down trend already below the retained 20-day range. Positioning: not observed. Driver: none identified; the pair rose 4 pips after the headline. Acceptance: FAILED for a USD haven bid; channel MIXED. Zone reason: price is inside the 1.09908-1.10194 H1 range. Invalidation reason: a close outside that range ends the range reading. Confirmations: none. Invalidation: completed H1 bar closing below 1.09908 or above 1.10194. Opposite mechanism: trend continuation on dollar strength.
Main alternative (49%): EURUSD is above 1.10023 at the horizon.

A completed H1 bar closing outside 1.09908-1.10194 ends the flat reading.

Base case (54%): GOLD is at or below 3858.864 at 2026-11-18T00:07:58Z, a weak lean from a failed haven bid. Mechanism: a real security shock should lift gold first; the pop to 3864.80 came before the headline and was given back after it. Priced: a 15.7% fall over 60 sessions, price at 0.02 of the 20-day range. Positioning: not observed. Driver: the rising-yield, strong-dollar regime, with the Iran report not paid for. Acceptance: FAILED (back below the 3862.89 level at the headline within 15 minutes); channel MIXED. Zone reason: price is mid-way in the 3840.978-3871.207 H1 box. Invalidation reason: an H1 close above 3871.207 would show the haven bid accepted. Confirmations: an H1 close below 3840.978. Invalidation: completed H1 bar closing above 3871.207. Opposite mechanism: official confirmation squeezes late shorts from the floor.
Main alternative (46%): GOLD is above 3858.864 at the horizon on confirmation or a floor bounce.

A completed H1 bar closing above 3871.207 ends the short lean.

Base case (52%): SPX is at or below 7424.41 at 2026-11-18T00:07:58Z, close to no lean. Mechanism: risk-off would show as lower futures; the response is 6 points, inside the last hour's range. Priced: a -2.3% session that closed near its low. Positioning: not observed. Driver: Monday's selloff and weaker Asia, not the headline. Acceptance: AMBIGUOUS; channel MIXED. Zone reason: price is 20 points above the H1 low shelf 7404.58-7411.13. Invalidation reason: a close outside 7404.58-7442.07 ends the range reading. Confirmations: none. Invalidation: completed H1 bar closing below 7404.58 or above 7442.07. Opposite mechanism: short covering after a weak close.
Main alternative (48%): SPX is above 7424.41 at the horizon.

A completed H1 bar closing outside 7404.58-7442.07 ends the flat reading.

Base case (52%): USDJPY is at or below 159.393 at 2026-11-18T00:07:58Z, a slight downside lean. Mechanism: yen haven bid with weaker Nikkei futures at the Tokyo open. Priced: an up trend at 0.81 of its 20-day range. Positioning: not observed. Driver: Tokyo-open risk-off after Wall Street, with the headline and the Trump posts not separable. Acceptance: ACCEPTED in direction but only 13 pips; channel MIXED. Zone reason: price is at the bottom of the 159.363-159.543 range. Invalidation reason: an H1 close below 159.363 breaks the range. Confirmations: an H1 close below 159.363 with SPX below 7404.58. Invalidation: completed H1 bar closing below 159.363 or above 159.589. Opposite mechanism: trend dip-buying.
Main alternative (48%): USDJPY is above 159.393 at the horizon as the dip is bought.

A completed H1 bar closing below 159.363 or above 159.589 ends the flat reading.

Base case (51%): WTI is at or above 84.022 at 2026-11-18T00:07:58Z, close to no lean. Mechanism: an alleged plot in Washington is not a supply event; oil needs a step toward action against Iran. Priced: a fall from the 104.04 range high to 84.02, -3.7% on Monday. Positioning: not observed. Driver: none from the headline; price unchanged. Acceptance: AMBIGUOUS; channel MIXED. Zone reason: price is inside the 83.820-84.371 H1 range at 0.05 of the 20-day range. Invalidation reason: a close outside 83.820-84.577 ends the range reading. Confirmations: none. Invalidation: completed H1 bar closing below 83.820 or above 84.577. Opposite mechanism: continuation of Monday's selling through the 20-day low 83.051.
Main alternative (49%): WTI is below 84.022 at the horizon.

A completed H1 bar closing outside 83.820-84.577 ends the flat reading.
